names.note: actor Vidyut Jammwal; also the modern Hindi word for electricity

names.name: Vihayas
names.note: poetic Sanskrit word for sky; not the same as the popular Vihaan

names.name: Vinamra
names.note: fresher than the older-generation Vinay/Vinit

names.name: Vinyas
names.note: also the arrangement of syllables in a raga phrase

names.name: Vishram
names.note: Vishram Bedekar; peaceful meaning, rarely used now

names.name: Vismay
names.note: used in Maharashtra and Gujarat; the rasa of wonder in aesthetics

names.name: Vivasvan
names.note: Bhagavad Gita 4.1: Krishna says he taught yoga first to Vivasvan

names.name: Viyat
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable
names.note: used in classical poetry for the vault of the sky; nearly unused as a given name

names.name: Vyas
names.say_note: the 'vy' onset needs a demo; Americans may say 'VIE-us'
names.note: The sage who divided the Vedas into four and composed the Mahabharata; Guru Purnima honors him.

names.name: Vyomkesh
names.collisions: Byomkesh Bakshi, the Bengali fictional detective

names.name: Yadu
names.note: Eldest son of Yayati whose line became the Yadavas, Krishna's clan; Krishna is called Yadunandan.

names.name: Yajat
names.meaning: holy, worthy of worship (epithet of Shiva)

names.name: Yuyutsu
names.meaning: eager to fight for the right
names.note: Mahabharata: Dhritarashtra's son by a Vaishya woman who alone crossed to the Pandava side at Kurukshetra and later ruled as regent
